entries.description: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list (default: none) (env: LLAMA_API_KEY)
entries.notes: Single-key authentication works with the same spelling and env. b10621 accepts a comma-separated key list; multi-key semantics are owned by #1437.

entries.description: path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments (default: none) (env: LLAMA_ARG_API_KEY_FILE)
entries.notes: Flag accepted; file-format parity (one key per line, hash comments) owned by #1437.
